meaning: The reported 236 unmatched memberships comprised 208 incorrect municipal aliases and 28 legitimate ward IDs absent from the ZIP index. Canonical local IDs replace the 208 municipal member values. Stable membership IDs stay unchanged. Metadata-only publication uses the existing explicit data update API; the ordinary record-change detector does not include memberships. All 348 whole municipalities reach their official Council district. Ward memberships are preserved without widening split cities.

readOnlyReplay.method: Normal contestsForDivisions on each corrected canonical member, then normal shardEntry plus contestsForDivisions on actual MA ZIP rows. Each corrected member selects exactly its one official Council contest; all eight districts have a real ZIP example.
